sources: docs/handoffs/ff-t1-gate-2026-07.md (FF-2D — T1 gate battery, six ISOs)
headline: No ISO clears the T1→T2 rubric gate at HEAD — all six read HOLD (FF-2D). No ISO clears the §2.1b full-solve authorization gate either (FF-3E). This board is the §2.1b evidence, not a green-wash: every remaining blocker is structural, routed to its L-CAP lane, none an FF-5A/dashboard target (rule 1).
gate_reading: The dominant T1-F blocker is FC-1 structural — the I4 capacity-accounting leak (the FF-0B "A1" finding, still open) for CAISO/PJM/MISO/NEISO, plus I7 base-year adequacy (A2) for CAISO/MISO/NYISO and ERCOT's I3 scarcity slack. PJM and NEISO are closest — their only T1-F blocker is the single I4 leak invariant; fix A1 and both clear FC-1. The FF-2C capacity-clearing flip is the structurally-correct mechanism and is working; the residuals it exposes are the open retirement-rule / backstop / capacity-accounting lanes, not tuning targets.
readiness: The FF-3E full-horizon readiness battery is GREEN for all six ISOs — the path is bug-free (input-resolution walk, config round-trip, kill-resume drill all clean; wall/RSS projected). Ten hours of compute today would buy a mechanically-clean but structurally-flawed golden run. Compute is not the binding constraint; the T1-F structural blockers are.

honest_unfit.title: Capacity-accounting leak
honest_unfit.detail: Steam/coal MW removed with no matching ledger retirements record — the dominant T1-F blocker (4/6 ISOs). Fix A1 and NEISO + PJM clear FC-1. Un-actioned since FF-0B; the ledger_version stamp did NOT touch it.

honest_unfit.title: Base-year adequacy
honest_unfit.detail: Hydro dispatched but excluded from the accredited firm-capacity ledger (accredited_firm_capacity_mw reads the persistent fleet, which never contains hydro). NEISO closed via the FF-2C flip.

honest_unfit.title: ERCOT scarcity slack
honest_unfit.detail: Slack 0.01–0.03% of load 2027–2030, plus the #2064 non-monotone scarcity signature — one-pass discreteness + cfo/AEO fuel.

honest_unfit.title: MISO gas_ct cobweb
honest_unfit.detail: NEW, FF-2C flip-induced → FC-2 FAIL. Alternating gas_ct entry loop under the priced curve.

honest_unfit.title: Frozen ERCOT golden fixture
honest_unfit.detail: tests/golden/ercot_2026_2040.json seeded f0f7c67 (use_campd_bins=False); bands moved (FF-1F DC=mid+cfo, FF-2A entry-lookahead, FF-G2 AEO fuel; 2030 LW $45→$79.5). Reseed is a 15-solve-year invocation — breaches the §2.1b 5-year cap; left un-widened and un-touched (a stale-but-honest fixture > a silently-regenerated one).

open_frontier.title: Retirement decision-rule inversion
open_frontier.detail: retirement_years_coal=3 eliminates PJM's coal wave in-window (recall 76%→0) and inverts MISO onto gas_st (8.6 GW false-retire). Consecutive-loss counters race fuels against each other. Blocks every flip.

open_frontier.title: ERCOT screen revenue level + in-year scarcity
open_frontier.detail: Correlated forced-outage derate landed (FF-1B); 2024 forms in-year scarcity on the un-staged fleet but is absorbed on the staged/threshold-3 fleet; Uri-2021 stays $0 (a demand-input gap). Residual ≈ 56–66 $/kW-yr to SOM.

open_frontier.detail: VRE capacity revenue measured near-pivotal; BLK-10 backstop 2.5→1.103 GW; ERCOT solar zero is a pure term-(a) price-signal residual (−9.7k best-year margin).
